test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 2 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is INCORRECT about Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)?

options.text: It was launched to promote organic farming.
In three years 2,00,000 clusters will be formed.
Every farmer under this scheme will be provided Rs. 20,000 per acre in three years for seeds, to harvest the crops and to transport the produce.

solution:
The correct answer is __**In three years 2,00,000 clusters will be formed**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana **(PKVY)– a **traditional farming improvement programme**.
 
• It was **launched **in **2015**.
 
• It is **an extended component **of **Soil Health Management **(SHM) under the **Centrally Sponsored Scheme **(CSS).
 
• **PKVY aims **at supporting and **promoting organic farming**, **reducing in dependence **on **fertilizers **and **agricultural chemicals**.
 
• **Organic food**, thus produced will be **linked with modern marketing tools **and local **markets**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Objectives**:

 
 
• The objective is to produce agricultural products free from chemicals and pesticidal residues by adopting eco-friendly, low-cost technologies.
 
• Promote organic farming among rural youth/ farmers/ consumers/ traders.
 
• Disseminate the latest technologies in organic farming.
 
• Utilize the services of experts from the public agricultural research system in India.
 
• Organize a minimum of one cluster demonstration in a village,
